TL;DR – Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Nachdem wir uns als Marktführer in der Zahnmedizin etabliert haben, gehen wir jetzt den nächsten großen Schritt: neue medizinische Fachbereiche, neue Länder, neue Produkte. Als Sales Development Representative bist du der erste persönliche Kontakt für Praxen, die Interesse an Luna zeigen: du rufst unsere eingehenden Leads an, begeisterst sie für unser Produkt und bringst sie in eine Demo. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unseren gesamten Vertrieb.

Wieso praxipal?

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Was du tun wirst

In einem Satz: du verwandelst das Interesse unserer eingehenden Leads in gebuchte Demos – und wächst dabei selbst schnell in mehr Verantwortung rein.

  • Du rufst unsere Inbound-Leads an und bringst sie in eine Demo

  • Du bist schnell am Telefon, gehst neue Leads zügig an und bleibst hartnäckig dran, bis der Termin steht

  • Du qualifizierst Leads, verstehst ihre Situation und weckst Begeisterung für Luna

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline mit vielen offenen Kontakten, bleibst mit sauberen Follow-ups am Ball und pflegst unser CRM

  • Du baust einen wiederholbaren Prozess auf, testest Gesprächsleitfäden und schärfst laufend, wie wir Leads am besten überzeugen

Wonach wir suchen

  • Du bringst erste Vertriebs- oder Telefonerfahrung mit

  • Du liebst das Telefon, führst gerne viele Gespräche am Tag und lässt dich von einem „Nein" nicht bremsen

  • Du bist hartnäckig und diszipliniert bei Follow-ups, kein Lead geht bei dir verloren

  • Du packst gerne selbst an und scheust dich auch vor unglamourösen Aufgaben nicht

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Du willst 5 Tage die Woche vor Ort in Berlin arbeiten

Deine Vorteile

  • Kompetitives Grundgehalt plus attraktive, ungedeckelte Provision und Beteiligung an unserem VSOP-Programm

  • Steile Lernkurve: du baust unseren Sales-Prozess von Grund auf mit auf und wächst mit außergewöhnlichem Tempo in mehr Verantwortung rein

  • Zusammenarbeit mit einem starken, motivierten Team und viele Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

  • Urban Sports Club

  • Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket

  • Lunch-Zuschuss via Lunchit und gemeinsame Abendessen auf Firmenkosten

  • Regelmäßige Team Events und Offsites

data.description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

YOUR JOB

Do you want to rethink information security consulting with AI? Are you excited to automate repetitive work, move faster and spend more time solving real customer challenges? Join us to combine your InfoSec expertise with AI, challenge inefficient ways of working and help shape how AI is used in security consulting.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You own and develop customer relationships across the full lifecycle of our InfoSec-SaaS product, acting as a trusted advisor on information security.

  • You advise customers on complex security challenges and build pragmatic, scalable ISMS solutions using our platform.

  • You independently guide customers through audits and certifications such as ISO 27001 and TISAX®.

  • You use AI to automate repetitive consulting work, accelerate analysis and preparation, and free up more time for high-value customer interaction and problem-solving.

  • You experiment with new AI-powered ways of working and help shape how we use AI across InfoSec consulting, turning successful approaches into scalable best practices.

  • You support Sales and Customer Success in identifying and developing cross-selling and up-selling opportunities with existing customers.

  • You bring customer and technical insights back into the organisation, helping us continuously improve our InfoSec product, tooling and consulting approach.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools you need to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company.

  • A competitive salary, flexible working hours tailored to your needs, and benefits catering to health, family, and sustainability.

  • A secure and future-proof job with a professional working atmosphere and the dynamics of a maturing scale-up.

  • The opportunity to develop into a mentoring role, empowering and supporting up-and-coming talent.

  • The opportunity and budget to further develop your existing skills and build new ones, including in AI and information security.

  • Lots of responsibility and the opportunity to actively shape and define the future of Security & Compliance, including how we use AI to work smarter and deliver more value to our customers.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in information security, IT security, GRC, compliance or a closely related field.

  • You have hands-on experience with information security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX® or NIST and can confidently apply this knowledge in a customer context.

  • You are technically curious and genuinely excited about AI, automation and finding smarter ways to solve problems.

  • You already use AI tools in your work or are hungry to experiment, learn quickly and help shape how AI can improve information security consulting.

  • You enjoy working directly with customers, can challenge their thinking when needed and turn complex technical or regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic solutions.

  • You take ownership, work independently and look for ways to improve how things are done rather than simply following existing processes.

  • You have excellent German and English communication skills.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

data.description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

  • Fleet Updates: Design OS and application updates that never brick a device: A/B partitions, staged rollouts and clean versioning across hardware variants.

  • Fleet Observability: Build monitoring that shows the health of every device in real time, from memory leaks to network stability and hardware metrics.

  • Debugging: Find root causes across kernel, drivers, networking, memory and application code, on devices hundreds of kilometers away.

  • Technical Guidance: Bring senior judgment into architecture discussions with our IoT Platform, Backend and AI teams, document decisions and mentor engineers.

INSPIRE US BY

  • Embedded Linux Expertise: Hands-on experience building and maintaining embedded Linux products that are deployed in the field, ideally at fleet scale, and confidence working with Linux internals, GNU tools, and Bash

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent practical experience

  • Yocto Experience: Proven experience building, customizing, and maintaining Linux images using Yocto

  • Python Development: Strong Python skills – Python will be your primary development language in this role

  • Systems Programming: Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as C++, Rust, Go, or Java

  • Operating System & Debugging: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker, plus hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG

  • Senior Mindset: You clarify requirements before designing a solution, consider the impact on other teams, and are comfortable making and defending technical decisions

  • Communication: You explain complex technical topics clearly and in a structured way, in fluent English (C1)

EXTRA POINTS FOR

  • Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets

  • Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems, or network devices

  • Experience with computer vision, edge AI, or machine learning

  • Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf)

  • German language skills

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

  • Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany

  • Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort

  • Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best

Innovation through diversity

Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

Still here?

Then we might be the perfect match!

Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Negotiate & close: Du führst Verhandlungen auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen, gehst souverän mit Einwänden um und bringst Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

  • Grow your accounts: Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifizierst weiteres Potenzial in bestehenden Accounts. Dein Ziel sind nicht nur gewonnene Deals, sondern nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

  • Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter.

Inspire us by

  • Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und kommunizierst souverän mit Entscheidern auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen.

  • Mobility: Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %).

What we offer

  • Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen.

  • Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Own your numbers: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln.

  • Work smarter with AI: KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung.

  • Flexibility & Mobility: Drei feste Office-Tage in München-Thalkirchen, flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Bike-Leasing oder Fahrtkostenzuschuss.

  • Team & Culture: Eine ambitionierte Teamkultur, kurze Wege und gemeinsame Erfolge bei Teamevents und OKR-Partys.

  • Health & Balance: EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

  • Best-in-class setup: Mac oder Windows, ergonomisches Equipment und alles, was du für effizientes Arbeiten im Office und Homeoffice brauchst.

  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst.

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Still here?

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

  • Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

  • Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

  • Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

  • Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

  • Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

  • Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

  • Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

  • Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2-L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Plankstadt

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. 

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. 


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces.
  • Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe.
  • Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility.
  • Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations.
  • Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability.
  • Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration
  • Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance.
  • Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. 

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms.
  • Very strong background in communication theory.
  • Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation).
  • Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS).
  • Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews.
  • Fluent in English (German language skills a plus).
  • Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. 

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.

    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems. 

 At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment.  

 The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems.
  • Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements.
  • Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals.
  • Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release.
  • Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development.
  • Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards.
  • Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
  • Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments.
  • Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities.
  • Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment.
  • Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification.
  • Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support technical design reviews, engineering documentation, requirements traceability, and customer-facing technical activities.
  • Contribute to product qualification, certification, manufacturing transfer, and production support activities.
  • Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.
  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians while promoting engineering best practices and technical rigor.
  • Apply knowledge of adjacent disciplines, including software, systems, RF, and mechanical engineering, to support efficient product development and integration.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Experience delivering hardware designs through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design and high-speed routing.
  • Experience running board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that guides hardware design and system design
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • Experience leading small teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, make/buy decisions, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments

👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

Internal Tech Stack:

CRM: Hubspot

Automation: N8N, Clay

Outreach: Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

AI Tooling: Claude Co-work/Code
Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

  • Proactive & Strategic Problem-Solving: A track record of independently identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks in processes, leading to measurable improvements in efficiency.

  • Operational Excellence & Project Ownership: Exceptional organisational skills with a demonstrated capability to manage multiple, high-priority projects concurrently, ensuring successful delivery within tight deadlines.

Nice to have’s

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field.

  • Expertise in Growth Stack Technologies: Hands-on experience and familiarity with core automation, analytics, and CRM systems, including specific platforms like Hubspot, N8N, Clay, Lemlist, and Make.

  • Content & Social: Experience running a company's or organisation's LinkedIn presence, or writing experience with an audience behind it - a newsletter or blog of your own.

  • Start-up Experience: Experience in a commercial or operational role in a startup or scaleup.

     

How we support you

Your team lead will be

  • Katharina Mas (Growth Engineer)

You will work with

  • Janos Gründling (Head of Growth)

  • Elise Lecocq (Sales Development)

  • Sara Power Millán (Partnerships)

  • Isabel Bommes Fernandez (Team Lead, Go-to-Market)

  • Sina Zamorano (Team Lead, Climate Success)

See our full benefits HERE, including:

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year (pro rata)

  • 📚 €500 Learning Budget

 

Admin:

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Role type: Full-Time Internship. Minimum 4 months

  • Location: Munich, Germany

  • Office Requirement: Office based

  • Visa / Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates already based in Munich and that do not require visa sponsorship. However, we are open to candidates who may need relocation or a visa.

Compensation: €3K – €3.3K per month

Du bist Arzt/Ärztin, kreativ, kommunikationsstark und behältst gerne den Überblick? Du bringst gerne Projekte pragmatisch voran und hast ein Talent für Organisation? Du willst tausenden Ärzt:innen ermöglichen, sich neben dem Klinik- und Praxisalltag mit AMBOSS-Fortbildungen online weiterbilden zu können?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine/einen Associate Medical Project Manager für den deutschsprachigen ärztlichen Markt. In dieser Rolle leitest du eigenverantwortlich die Erstellung von medizinischen Online-CME-Fortbildungen. Dabei vernetzt du die Teams aus Redaktion, Videoproduktion, Design, Marketing und externe Kooperationspartner:innen miteinander. Dank deiner ärztlichen Perspektive ist AMBOSS auch weiterhin von Mediziner:innen für Mediziner:innen!

Was deine Aufgabe sein wird

  • Schwerpunkt ist das Projektmanagement für die Erstellung von Online-Fortbildungen und -Kursen aller Fachrichtungen für Ärzt:innen im deutschsprachigen Raum

  • Mitwirkung bei der Auswahl von geeigneten Fortbildungsthemen und Formaten

  • Konzeption und didaktische Aufbereitung der zu schulenden Fachinhalte

  • Du wirst Hauptansprechpartner:in für deinen zu betreuenden Kurs sein – vom Start des Projekts bis zur Veröffentlichung

  • Intensive Kommunikation und Austausch mit zusammenarbeitenden Teams innerhalb von AMBOSS, sowie mit externen Kooperationspartner:innen

Was du mitbringst

  • Organisierte, gut strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise

  • Abgeschlossenes Humanmedizinstudium

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

  • Pluspunkt: Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement, Arbeitserfahrung in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld, Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder der BWL

Pluspunkt: Klinische Erfahrung von mind. 1–3 Jahren

Warum AMBOSS?

AMBOSS ist ein starkes und effizientes Lerntool für das Medizinstudium und Hilfsmittel für ärztliche Entscheidungen im Klinikalltag, das Ärzt:innen weltweit zur bestmöglichen Patientenversorgung befähigen will. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012 nutzen wir die neueste Technologie, um das umfangreichste Lern- und Nachschlagewerk auf dem Markt zu entwickeln und die Wissensaneignung von Medizinstudierenden und Ärzt:innen zu revolutionieren.

Bereits 2017 haben wir die Lernerfahrung für 95% des deutschen Marktes verbessert. Im selben Jahr führten wir zusätzlich unsere internationale Plattform ein. Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our sales development team. You’ll join a people-focused business that is putting AI at the center of how manufacturers and distributors price, quote and manage incentives, with a real opportunity to accelerate your career in enterprise SaaS sales.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity.

You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives. You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment.


THE OPPORTUNITY
  • Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers.
  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.
  • Qualify inbound leads against set criteria, using strong questioning to identify true fit and move the right opportunities forward.
  • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.
  • Build a solid understanding of our technology and solutions, and clearly explain the problems we solve and the value we deliver to prospects.
  • Lead team meetings on relevant topics, share learnings and new strategies to improve SDR performance, and take part in weekly pipeline reviews.
  • Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams.
  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.
  • Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures.
  • Contribute to and lead team meetings on a monthly basis on topics relevant to the role. 
  • Pipeline review with weekly team meeting 
  • Other duties as assigned. 

    •  

     


    THE SKILL SET
  • Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives.
  • Fluent English and German speaker.
  • Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision.
  • Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach).
  • Stays current with AI and prospecting tools, and tests and applies them to improve outreach quality and efficiency.
  • Experience calling into Fortune 1000 accounts preferred.
  • Ability to understand and successfully promote technical offerings and solution sets, supported by strong curiosity about business problems and product value.
  • Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and strong planning skills.
  • Demonstrated coachability - you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously refine your approach.
  • Creative approach to outreach, with the ability to build sequences and test new messaging and cadences across email, phone and social channels.
  • Strong self-learning mindset: proactive in developing your sales craft through reading, testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong ownership mentality - takes responsibility for pipeline creation, follow-through, and results without outsourcing challenges.
  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift efforts based on business goals and team needs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Claude, including running account and contact research, creating and maintaining projects with reusable context, using and building Claude skills for repeatable workflows (research, call prep, sequence drafting), and checking outputs before they reach a prospect.
  • Ambitious about long-term career growth in sales, with a clear desire to progress into quota-carrying roles.
  • Must be able to travel as needed (For marketing / sales events and internal meetups in Europe and Sales Kick-Off in the U.S) 

    • THE BENEFITS
  • Fully remote based with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany
  • Flexible working hours
  • Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
  • 30 vacation days per year in addition to public holidays
  • 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday
  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year
  • Risk Insurance
  • Travel insurance for business travels
  • Cell phone reimbursement up to 90€ EUR per month
  • High-end laptop (Windows or Mac)
  • Competitive pay and bonus/commission
    •  
    THE VENDAVO STORY 
    Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people. 
     
    OUR SAAS PRODUCTS

    OUR FUNDING
    We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.
     
    OUR CULTURE & YOU
    We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners.
     
    Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments.

ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

    • You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

    • Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it 

  • Experience in managing Stakeholders and expectations from Stakeholders 

  • Experience in dealing with concurring priorities / context switching 

  • Proficiency in Python.

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in Germany, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.
